Class ConfigurationManager

java.lang.Object
dev.despical.pixelpainter.config.ConfigurationManager
public final class ConfigurationManager extends Object
Creates bundled configuration files and publishes validated resource snapshots.

A reload first reads settings, messages and the block palette into local candidates. Active references change only after all candidates are valid, so a malformed resource cannot leave the plugin partly reconfigured.

Call this manager on the server thread: palette validation resolves Bukkit block data. Existing image preparations and painting jobs keep the settings and colors they captured before a later reload.
